quests.title: In the Aftermath

dialogue.t: *sigh* If we just had a couple more people on hand...

dialogue.sit: What are the other knights doing?
You could solicit help from the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogue.t: Maintaining the city's defenses, helping with the rebuilding effort, and a whole host of other odd jobs.
Every last knight we have is up to their eyeballs in work right now.
For once, guard duty at the main gate is the relatively easy job.
How's your progress? Finished clearing the area yet?
Fantastic. You've been an enormous help, who knows how much longer those ugly things would've been stood there otherwise...
Honorary Knight, please accept these as an expression of my gratitude.

quests.description: Huffman has his hands full with the cleanup work that followed the storm…
